text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 500 communal farmers in Zimbabwe's Mashonaland province are expected to benefit from a Z$20 million dam project financed by a syndicate of commercial farmers in the area.

- Zimbabwe's state-owned central mechanical equipment department has so far realised Z$12 million from the public auctioning of its old fleet of vehicles and equipment as it gears towards commercialisation.
- An employee at state-owned Air Zimbabwe appeared in court on Tuesday on charges of facilitating departures from Zimbabwe of people with forged travel documents, costing the airline Z$3 million.
